# Tokyo Express: start of a run - initial attach + strength push.
JAP_te_apply_supply_effect = {
	JAP_te_refresh_supply_effect = yes
	JAP_te_push_supply_effect = yes
}

# Tokyo Express: turn JAP_te_band into a supply strength (band x 0.05) and
# push it onto the per-state variable the JAP_te_supply modifier reads.
JAP_te_push_supply_effect = {
	set_variable = { JAP_te_strength = JAP_te_band }
	multiply_variable = { JAP_te_strength = 0.05 }
	if = { # 60 West Indian Ocean
		limit = { check_variable = { global.JAP_te_region_active = 60 } }
		543 = { set_variable = { JAP_te_supply_var = JAP.JAP_te_strength } }
		709 = { set_variable = { JAP_te_supply_var = JAP.JAP_te_strength } }
		710 = { set_variable = { JAP_te_supply_var = JAP.JAP_te_strength } }

# Tokyo Express: end of a run (rounds exhausted or flotilla wiped) - detach
# the modifier and zero the region selector, which also disables the
# generated ai_strategy blocks and the running-status card.
JAP_te_remove_supply_effect = {
	if = { # 60 West Indian Ocean
		limit = { check_variable = { global.JAP_te_region_active = 60 } }
		543 = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = JAP_te_supply } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = JAP_te_supply }
			}
			set_variable = { JAP_te_supply_var = 0 }
		}
		709 = {
			if = {

# Re-elects each region's anchor state: the highest-priority held state
# (priority = coastal contact desc, state id asc) gets the region's anchor
# flag, so exactly ONE map icon shows per sea region. 'Held' is defined by
# JAP_te_state_held_trigger (scripted_triggers/JAP_rework_scripted_triggers.txt).
# Called daily (on_daily_JAP) and after seeding.
JAP_te_refresh_anchors_effect = {
	every_state = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor }
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_60
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_71
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_72
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_73
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_75
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_80
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_81
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_83
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_84
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_85
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_91
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_92
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_93
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_97
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_98
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_100
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_101
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_102
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_103
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_104
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_203
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_229
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_231
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_252
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_280
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_308
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_309
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_323
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_324
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_325
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_331
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_333
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_335
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_354
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_361
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_362
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_363
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_364
		clr_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_372
	}
	# 60 West Indian Ocean: 543 > 709 > 710
	if = {
		limit = { 543 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		543 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_60
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 709 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		709 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_60
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 710 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		710 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_60
		}
	}
	# 71 Central Indian Ocean: 712
	if = {
		limit = { 712 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		712 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_71
		}
	}
	# 72 Straits of Malacca: 862 > 672 > 336 > 724
	if = {
		limit = { 862 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		862 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_72
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 672 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		672 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_72
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 336 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		336 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_72
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 724 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		724 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_72
		}
	}
	# 73 Gulf of Thailand: 724 > 289 > 741 > 286 > 862
	if = {
		limit = { 724 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		724 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_73
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 289 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		289 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_73
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 741 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		741 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_73
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 286 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		286 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_73
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 862 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		862 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_73
		}
	}
	# 75 South China Sea: 671 > 623 > 976 > 591 > 593 > 931 > 327 > 592 > 524 > 595 > 626 > 326 > 624 > 728 > 729
	if = {
		limit = { 671 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		671 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_75
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 623 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
